# A 100.00 CAD deposit whose bank split carries an action and a memo.
#
# The transaction and both splits give their guids, so a second file can edit
# them with `--strategy update`.
#
# What this fixture produces: one CAD transaction, "Consulting paid", its bank
# split with action "Deposit" and memo "first".
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_value_of_none_on_a_split_field_says_nothing.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

2026-01-10 * "Consulting paid"
	guid: "d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1d1"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 100.00 CAD
		guid: "e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1"
		action: "Deposit"
		memo: "first"
	Income:Sales -100.00 CAD
		guid: "f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1f1"
